segments.name: Digital currency mining
segments.description: Generates and sells hashrate from ASIC mining rigs in its data centers to mining pools for Bitcoin rewards.
segments.evidence: Revenue from digital currency mining was $67.2 million for the current period compared to $28.1 million in the prior comparative period.

segments.name: High performance computing hosting
segments.description: Rents GPU clusters and cloud capacity in its data centers to AI enterprises, institutions and start-ups.
segments.evidence: In addition, the Company is branching out into the rental of GPU server clusters via marketplace aggregators and direct contracts and is developing new cloud service offerings.

revenueModel.text: Third-party aggregators, including mining pools and AI enterprises, pay for computational power sold from the company's data centers.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company sells computational power to various third-party aggregators, including mining pools, enterprises supported by AI, and other miscellaneous data center applications.
